--- alter_sequence_restart_no_skip.sql
ALTER SEQUENCE S RESTART COUNTER WITH 3 NO SKIP RANGE

--- AST
&ast.AlterSequence{
  SequenceEnd: 53,
  Name:        &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 15,
        NameEnd: 16,
        Name:    "S",
      },
    },
  },
  RestartCounterWith: &ast.RestartCounterWith{
    Restart: 17,
    Counter: &ast.IntLiteral{
      ValuePos: 38,
      ValueEnd: 39,
      Base:     10,
      Value:    "3",
    },
  },
  NoSkipRange: &ast.NoSkipRange{
    No:    40,
    Range: 48,
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER SEQUENCE S RESTART COUNTER WITH 3 NO SKIP RANGE
